stem: 以下哪些措施有助于保持BSA/AML合规人员的独立性，以确保有效的合规控制？

options.A: 在第一道防线中设立向业务线管理层汇报的BSA/AML合规人员
options.B: 确保BSA/AML合规人员主要为外包人员
options.C: 为BSA/AML合规人员提供向合规部门或其他第二道防线内部控制职能部门汇报的渠道
options.D: 为BSA/AML合规人员提供向首席财务官汇报的渠道

stem_en: Which of the following measures can help maintain the independence of BSA/AML compliance staff to ensure effective compliance controls?

options_en.A: Establishing BSA/AML compliance staff reporting to the management of the business line in the first line of defense
options_en.B: Ensuring BSA/AML compliance staff is primarily outsourced
options_en.C: Providing BSA/AML compliance staff with a reporting line to compliance or other second line of defense internal control function
options_en.D: Providing BSA/AML compliance staff with a reporting line to the chief financial officer
